title: Ore³
description: Aims to add 100+ ores, and a unique twist to how you get them
body:
**Are you tired of the vanilla ores? Do you want some new spice to your world? Well this mod has just the thing for you! This mod adds a lot of custom ores, with unique methods on how to obtain them**
## **READ BELOW**

```
This mod's development has been delayed indefinitely.
```

Scroll down if you want a more "technical" view of exactly how strong each ore set is. (work in progress)

Upcoming ores: Cobalt, Amethyst, Titanium, Echo, Leaf, VoidSteel, Zephyr, Chromium.

## Current Ores, listed from strongest to weakest:

1. Rubium: Fully implemented except armor.
2. Cobalt: All textures implemented - Making Items



## Generation:

- Rubium: Y=16 to Y=32 | Replaces stone | Usually found in veins of one
- Cobalt: Y=-48 to Y=128 | Replaces andesite | Usually found in veins of thirteen

## The technical stuff

<details>
<summary>Tool efficiency</summary>

### Tool efficiency:
- Wooden tools have 2.
- Stone tools have 4.
- Iron tools have 6.
- Cobalt tools have 7.
- Diamond tools have 8.
- Netherite tools have 9.
- Gold tools have 12.
- Rubium tools have 15.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Enchantability</summary>

### Enchantability:
(how good your enchants will be if using an enchanting table)
- Books: 1
- Stone tools: 5
- Diamond tools: 10
- Cobalt tools: 10
- Iron tools: 14
- Wooden tools: 15
- Netherite tools: 15
- Gold tools: 22
- Rubium tools: 25

</details>


<details>
<summary>Durability</summary>

### Durability
- Cobalt: 512
- Rubium: 4096
</details>


<details>
<summary>Attack stats</summary>

### Attack damage + Attack speed (if custom)

- Cobalt: 3 Attack Damage, Axe: 5 Attack Damage
- Rubium: 9 Attack Damage, 1.4 Attack Speed, Axe: 12 Attack Damage, 0.8 Attack Speed


</details>


<details>
<summary>Block drops tier</summary>

### Block drops tier:
(what tools can break what, example you need at least iron to mine diamond ore)

- Cobalt = Iron
- Rubium = Netherite

</details>


<details>
<summary>⬆️ Tier needed to mine ore</summary>

### Tool drop tier needed to mine ore:

- Cobalt = Stone+
- Rubium = Diamond+ 

</details>

**It takes around 15-30 minutes to fully implement an ore (except armor). ~~Expect 1-8 ores per day for at least the first week of release.~~ I have decided to add 10-20 ores every update, so expect an update every month or so, except for bugfixes and texture changes.**  


```
This mod will likely stay exclusive to Neoforge 1.21.4 for quite some time due to me using https://mcreator.net/ to develop this mod.
```
